name: PixelLetter
author: Fabian Bitter
description: Sends physical letters and faxes through the PixelLetter interface. Hand it a PDF or plain text plus an address and it is printed, franked and posted. Registered mail, colour and duplex options, and a test mode that submits an order without printing or charging.

PIXELLETTER_EMAIL.description: E-mail address the PixelLetter account is registered with

PIXELLETTER_DEFAULT_DESTINATION.description: Default destination country as a two letter ISO code

PIXELLETTER_FORCE_TEST_MODE.description: Force test mode for every order so nothing is printed, sent or charged
